steps.en: Officer searches notices and gets a result list
steps.id: Officer mencari notice dan mendapat daftar hasil

steps.en: Result page has download buttons for all or selected rows
steps.id: Halaman hasil punya tombol download untuk semua atau baris terpilih

steps.en: Download re-runs the same search so the file matches the list
steps.id: Download menjalankan ulang pencarian yang sama sehingga file cocok dengan daftar

steps.en: Results above one thousand notices cannot be downloaded
steps.id: Hasil di atas seribu notice tidak bisa di-download
steps.why_en: Downloads are blocked once a search returns more than 1,000 notices.
steps.why_id: Download ditolak kalau hasil pencarian lebih dari 1.000 notice.

steps.en: Results are saved as an Excel report with notice columns
steps.id: Hasil disimpan sebagai laporan Excel dengan kolom notice
steps.why_en: Five columns (summons, NTAC, court date, payment date, authorising officer) are always blank.
steps.why_id: Lima kolom (summons, NTAC, tanggal sidang, tanggal bayar, petugas pemberi izin) selalu kosong.

steps.en: Outstanding search results download with an outstanding-notice report layout
steps.id: Hasil pencarian outstanding di-download dengan susunan laporan outstanding

steps.en: Settled notices can be reported, but payment status may be wrong
steps.id: Notice settled bisa dilaporkan, tapi status bayar bisa salah
steps.why_en: Any payment reason prints as Fully Paid, so partly paid notices look settled.
steps.why_id: Alasan pembayaran apa pun tercetak Fully Paid, jadi notice yang baru dibayar sebagian tampak lunas.

steps.en: Search results can also be printed
steps.why_en: There is no print option, only download to Excel.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada opsi cetak, hanya download ke Excel.
